# ExecuTorch runtime as an ESP-IDF component.
#
# GENERATED by examples/espressif/build_idf_component.sh in the ExecuTorch repo
# -- do not edit this tree by hand. Source lists live in et_generated.cmake next
# to this file. Kernels are registered from the project's kernel bundle by
# __executorch_finalize in project_include.cmake.

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/et_generated.cmake)

idf_component_register(
  SRCS
  ${ET_CORE_SRCS}
  "src/et_model.cpp"
  "src/platform/esp_pal.cpp"
  INCLUDE_DIRS
  "include"
  PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS
  "priv_include"
  PRIV_REQUIRES
  esp_hw_support
  esp_system
  esp_timer
  log
  heap
  freertos
  esp-nn
)

# Plain static libraries, so the link pulls in only the kernels that the
# bundle's registration references, and the ESP-NN delegate only when a model
# uses it. __executorch_finalize links each only when it is needed, so other
# projects never build them. A project may provide esp-nn as its own
# components/esp-nn instead of the managed espressif__esp-nn.
idf_build_get_property(_build_components BUILD_COMPONENTS)
if("espressif__esp-nn" IN_LIST _build_components)
  idf_component_get_property(_espnn_lib espressif__esp-nn COMPONENT_LIB)
else()
  idf_component_get_property(_espnn_lib esp-nn COMPONENT_LIB)
endif()
set(_et_kernels ${COMPONENT_LIB}_kernels)
set(_et_espnn ${COMPONENT_LIB}_espnn)
add_library(${_et_kernels} STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${ET_KERNEL_SRCS})
add_library(
  ${_et_espnn} STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL ${ET_ESPNN_SRCS} "src/espnn_anchor.cpp"
)
foreach(_lib ${_et_kernels} ${_et_espnn})
  target_link_libraries(${_lib} PRIVATE ${COMPONENT_LIB} ${_espnn_lib})
endforeach()
target_link_libraries(
  ${_et_espnn} PRIVATE idf::esp_timer idf::heap idf::freertos
)
target_include_directories(${_et_espnn} PRIVATE priv_include)

# Vendored ExecuTorch sources use ExecuTorch's own deprecated aliases, and
# selective registration leaves some of their helpers unused.
set(_et_source_options "-Wno-deprecated-declarations;-Wno-unused-function")
set_source_files_properties(
  ${ET_CORE_SRCS} ${ET_KERNEL_SRCS} ${ET_ESPNN_SRCS}
  PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "${_et_source_options}"
)

set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY EXECUTORCH_COMPONENT_LIB ${COMPONENT_LIB})
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY EXECUTORCH_COMPONENT_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
set_property(
  GLOBAL PROPERTY EXECUTORCH_COMPONENT_VERSION ${ET_COMPONENT_VERSION}
)
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY EXECUTORCH_PRIM_OPS_SRC ${ET_PRIM_OPS_SRC})
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY EXECUTORCH_SOURCE_OPTIONS "${_et_source_options}")
cmake_language(DEFER DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR} CALL __executorch_finalize)

target_compile_features(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

if(CONFIG_ET_PROGRAM_VERIFICATION)
  set(_et_program_verification 1)
else()
  set(_et_program_verification 0)
endif()

# Consumers including <executorch/...> headers need the same c10 macro mode the
# runtime was built with. __FUNCTION__ instead of __builtin_FUNCTION() keeps log
# function names without full signatures.
target_compile_definitions(
  ${COMPONENT_LIB}
  PUBLIC C10_USING_CUSTOM_GENERATED_MACROS ET_USE_BUILTIN_FUNCTION_NAME=0
  PRIVATE FLATBUFFERS_MAX_ALIGNMENT=1024
          ET_ENABLE_PROGRAM_VERIFICATION=${_et_program_verification}
)
foreach(_target ${COMPONENT_LIB} ${_et_kernels} ${_et_espnn})
  if(NOT CONFIG_ET_DEBUG_ASSERTS)
    target_compile_definitions(${_target} PRIVATE NDEBUG)
  endif()
  if(CONFIG_ET_OPTIMIZE_SIZE)
    target_compile_options(${_target} PRIVATE -Os)
  endif()
endforeach()

# Newlib's nano printf cannot format 64-bit integers, which ExecuTorch's error
# messages print, so logging one could crash the app.
if(CONFIG_ET_ENABLE_LOGGING AND CONFIG_LIBC_NEWLIB_NANO_FORMAT)
  message(
    WARNING
      "ExecuTorch logging is DISABLED: CONFIG_LIBC_NEWLIB_NANO_FORMAT selects "
      "newlib's nano printf, which cannot format the 64-bit integers in "
      "ExecuTorch's error messages. Use Picolibc (ESP-IDF's default) or turn "
      "off nano formatting to keep ExecuTorch logging."
  )
endif()
if(NOT CONFIG_ET_ENABLE_LOGGING OR CONFIG_LIBC_NEWLIB_NANO_FORMAT)
  target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC ET_LOG_ENABLED=0)
endif()

# ET_MIN_LOG_LEVEL compiles out ET_LOG calls below the floor; ET_ESP_LOG_LEVEL
# applies the same floor in esp_pal.cpp. ExecuTorch has no warning level, so
# WARN keeps only errors.
if(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_ERROR)
  set(_et_min_log_level Error)
  set(_et_esp_log_level ESP_LOG_ERROR)
elseif(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_WARN)
  set(_et_min_log_level Error)
  set(_et_esp_log_level ESP_LOG_WARN)
elseif(CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG)
  set(_et_min_log_level Debug)
  set(_et_esp_log_level ESP_LOG_DEBUG)
else() # CONFIG_ET_LOG_LEVEL_INFO (default)
  set(_et_min_log_level Info)
  set(_et_esp_log_level ESP_LOG_INFO)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(
  ${COMPONENT_LIB}
  PUBLIC ET_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=${_et_min_log_level}
  PRIVATE ET_ESP_LOG_LEVEL=${_et_esp_log_level}
)
